name: component-expansion-port-count-mismatch-is-rejected
source:
COMPONENT Heater(in, out)
  PARAM Q = 1000
  out.mdot = in.mdot
  out.P    = in.P
  out.h    = in.h + Q / in.mdot
  duty     = Q
END
Heater H1(s1)

error.message: Component 'h1' (heater) binds 1 port(s) but COMPONENT heater declares 2 (in, out). Bind every port to a stream, or none and wire them with connect(...).
